meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) settings and features: ISettingProvider/ISettingManager, SettingDefinitionProvider, IFeatureChecker, feature toggle. Use for configuration management, settings, or feature flags in ABP.

copy.tagline: 管理 ABP 应用的设置项与功能开关
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 ABP Framework 开发，需要管理设置和功能开关。
copy.tagline_en: Manage settings and feature toggles for ABP apps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing with ABP Framework and need to manage settings and feature flags.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能帮你处理 ABP Framework 的设置和功能开关，包括定义设置、读取设置值、管理用户/租户/全局设置，以及定义功能、检查功能和设置功能值。
howto.when: 当你询问 ABP 设置或功能开关相关概念、代码或用法时触发，例如提到 ISettingProvider、ISettingManager、IFeatureChecker 等关键词。

say.text: 告诉我如何在 ABP 中定义一个新的设置。
怎样检查一个功能是否对当前租户启用？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help with ABP Framework settings and feature toggles: defining settings, reading values, managing user/tenant/global scopes, and defining features, checking enabled status, setting values.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about ABP settings or feature toggles, such as ISettingProvider, ISettingManager, IFeatureChecker, etc.

say_en.text: How to define a new setting in ABP?
How to check if a feature is enabled for current tenant?
